# Research Projects {.unnumbered}

This part of the portfolio collects **independent research projects** I conducted throughout the past school year. Where the earlier chapters work through coursework datasets and standard machine-learning methods, the projects here are longer-form, self-directed investigations — each one framing a question, gathering or preparing data, applying statistical and machine-learning techniques, and writing up the findings.

Use the **sidebar** to open either project, or the links above. Each page is a self-contained write-up; you can read them in any order.
